# Cave Pony v0.1.0 — public preview

Cave Pony is an MIT-licensed coding-agent skill for the smallest trustworthy change: **do less, say less, prove enough**.

This is the first tagged public preview. It is **not** a v1.0.0 stable release, and installation-path checks do not prove the skill changes a model's behaviour.

## In this preview

- One independently authored contract balancing implementation footprint, human attention, and evidence proportional to risk.
- Full, lite, ultra, and read-only audit modes, with separately selectable build and voice levels.
- Explicit rules for destructive actions, trust boundaries, authentication, secrets, data integrity, accessibility, compatibility, and recovery.
- A documented development and installation path for Claude Code, Codex, Hermes Agent, and OpenClaw. These are installation-layout observations, **not** behavioural-support certifications.
- Public examples, provenance and retained MIT notices for the two projects that inspired Cave Pony, and honestly scoped field-test records.

## Install this exact version

To make an immutable checkout, run:

```bash
git clone --depth 1 --branch v0.1.0 https://github.com/wilfgrainger/cave-pony.git
```

Then copy `cave-pony/skills/cave-pony` to your host's documented skills directory; see [Installation](https://github.com/wilfgrainger/cave-pony/blob/v0.1.0/docs/INSTALLATION.md). To try the moving public preview via the skills CLI instead, follow the command in the [README](https://github.com/wilfgrainger/cave-pony#quick-start).

Before installing any agent skill, read its `SKILL.md`. Cave Pony requires no runtime package or API credentials.

## What has actually been verified

- Automated repository validation, tests, and a clean Codex project installation in GitHub Actions.
- Previously documented clean remote installation into the Claude Code, Codex, Hermes Agent, and OpenClaw project layouts, using pinned `skills@1.5.9`.
- Previously documented Codex install/update/remove/backup-restore checks.
- A release job that retests the exact commit and checks the public tagged archive before publishing these notes.

[Host verification and limitations](https://github.com/wilfgrainger/cave-pony/blob/v0.1.0/docs/HOST_VERIFICATION.md) describe the evidence without extending the claim to real model behaviour.

## Known limitations and next evidence

- Three independent real-repository field tests, including a fresh authenticated Codex behaviour test, remain outstanding: [issue #21](https://github.com/wilfgrainger/cave-pony/issues/21).
- Fresh authenticated behavioural testing for other hosts, wider interrupted-operation recovery testing, and independent branding diligence remain incomplete.
- The repository social preview and its mobile/desktop rendering need an external GitHub-settings check: [issue #23](https://github.com/wilfgrainger/cave-pony/issues/23).
- Cave Pony does not publish comparative numerical performance claims and is not a fork or an official successor of Ponytail or Caveman.

We welcome neutral and unsuccessful field-test results as well as successes. Please use the [field-test template](https://github.com/wilfgrainger/cave-pony/blob/v0.1.0/field-tests/TEMPLATE.md).

For improvements or non-sensitive bug reports, open a GitHub issue. For sensitive findings, see the [security policy](https://github.com/wilfgrainger/cave-pony/blob/v0.1.0/SECURITY.md).
